notes.title: Ver1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new sheep color and a new cow color.  
[*] Improved compatibility with mod animals. If your pasture contains animals from unsubscribed mods, they will now automatically be removed upon launching the game to prevent crashes.  
[*] Introduced a new "Starry Night" background in the shop (perfect for players facing black screen issues—it can cover up your dark skies).  
[*] Added a confirmation pop-up when selling higher rarity animals to avoid accidental actions.  
[/list]
[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Placement restrictions for non-harvestable decorations have been greatly reduced. You can now stack them as you wish!  
[*] Moved the animal breeding interface from the shop to the management panel, allowing simultaneous breeding and card drawing.  
[*] Fixed a bug where switching between multiple screens with different resolutions could cause pasture display errors (your broom and the little house on the right should no longer disappear).  
[/list]

notes.title: Ver1.0.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed text overflow issues in certain languages.
[*] Adjusted the backup save system to prevent rapid overwrites. The system now keeps backups for the last 7 days (24 hours per day), with only one backup retained per hour.
[*] Fixed an animation playback issue for specific Ghostie variations.
[*] Added a DLC management button. Once the DLC is officially released, players will be able to enable or disable it here.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver1.0.12 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, pasture keepers! 

Exciting news—"Tiny Pasture" is gearing up for an update this April! Your Pasture is about to welcome some fresh new members, so stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592330/_/

Here’s a rundown of what’s coming in this update:

[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve disabled the "Transfer Animal" button during breeding animations to prevent unexpected issues
[*] Now you have more backup save slots to avoid accidental overwrites
[*] Added full localization support for Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), and Turkish
[*] Revamped localizations for French, German, Spanish (Spain), Russian, Polish, Portuguese, and Korean
[/list]
(If you notice any translation hiccups, feel free to let us know in our community)  

[h2]Fixes & Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where switching pastures caused the money sign to misalign when using Little Brick House
[*] Adjusted how the magic broom behaves to ensure it stays within the desktop boundaries
[*] Adjusted the logic for decorations that drop fruit, reducing the chance of animals getting stuck at the edges of the screen
[*] Resolved an issue where some prompts weren’t localized properly
[*] Fixed a bug where facilities weren’t saved correctly when switching pastures
[/list]

notes.title: Ver1.0.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]New Feature: Pasture Switching[/h2]

You can now switch Pastures through the management interface by clicking the "Switch to this Pasture" button. Once switched, the management display order will automatically update(keeping the active Pasture at the top).

Switching pastures also changes the background, decorations, and facility positions. If any facilities end up outside the screen after switching, you’ll need to manually adjust their positions in the store.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where animals in the warehouse weren’t cleared when starting a new game.
[*] Fixed translation errors in Russian, French, Polish, and other languages.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver1.0.9 patch notes【fixes related to the black background issue】
notes.notes:
Hey! Pasture Keepers!

We've been hard at work these past few days tackling the black background issue, and it looks like we've found a solution. If you're still experiencing the black screen problem, try uninstalling and reinstalling the game—it should fix the issue!

If reinstalling doesn't solve the problem, please check out some solutions we've gathered in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3167550/discussions/0/632295902087749042/]discussions table[/url]. A few players have also shared other fixes, and we've compiled them for you. Big thanks to everyone!

If none of these solutions work for you, don't worry. We're currently developing a dynamic sky feature that will cover the black screen at the bottom. This dynamic sky will be added to the Store - Decorations and can overlay any in-game background. Check out the GIF below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172897/1a0245ae29e823aad7859cce5fb8c7df9973880d.gif[/img]

(This feature is still in development, and this GIF does not represent the final result)
We hope this helps ease the black background issue!

[h3]Patch Note:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed translation errors in Portuguese, French, German, Spanish, and Polish.
[*] Another attempt to fix the black background issue (requires uninstalling and reinstalling the game).
[*] Added a sorting option based on the earnings rate.
[/list]

notes.title: 📢 Tiny Pasture set to release on February 18!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The adorable little animals are finally ready to meet you all! Our game, Tiny Pasture, will officially launch at 10:00 AM on February 18th(UTC+8)!
The full game will feature a total of 15 different animals and various pasture decorations. Plus, all the facilities and items from the demo version will be fully available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172897/d596774980ed6f1afd2691058a7bc0e091c7e74e.gif[/img]

Come to your desktop and start raising cute animals!

We also want to apologize, as the full version of the game has added many new features, the demo data cannot be carried over. We've added some features based on your suggestions to make the game easier to play, and we hope this will enhance your gaming experience.
If you have any suggestions or feedback about the game, feel free to click this link: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdFVMhUD4ruXXdat2DzIh0Plf5Lg5RGMqorWru-OBX-GpoDaA/viewform]Bugs & Feedback[/url]
We'll review every piece of feedback you send!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172897/cf02b4f7507a90b7592b2f3b5bba43fd4dcab4cc.png[/img]

If you enjoy the game, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
